research.label: Research
research.description: Gathers context from sanctioned public sources.

planning.label: Planning
planning.description: Turns research into approved work items.

build.label: Build
build.description: Executes approved work items and publishes artifacts.

approved-state.label: Approved state
approved-state.description: Storage the architecture sanctions for hand-offs.

shared-state.label: Shared state
shared-state.description: Ad-hoc storage that no approved workflow relies on.

invariants.description: An actor must not execute content authored by a different actor through storage the architecture does not declare.

control_capabilities.label: Block Research Agent writes to the unregistered task queue
control_capabilities.rationale: Closes the instruction channel at its source while leaving both actors fully able to do their declared work.

control_capabilities.label: Block Build Agent execution from the unregistered task queue
control_capabilities.rationale: Also closes the channel, but leaves untrusted content accumulating where a future consumer could reach it.

control_capabilities.label: Quarantine the unregistered task queue entirely
control_capabilities.rationale: Isolates the resource completely. Certain to work, heavier than needed.

control_capabilities.label: Block Research Agent calls to the public source
control_capabilities.rationale: Removes the untrusted upstream but leaves the cross-actor execution channel standing. Included so the planner must show the channel is the problem.

control_capabilities.label: Block Build Agent execution of approved jobs
control_capabilities.rationale: Stops the build agent from doing its declared job without touching the unregistered channel at all.

context.note: Research pulls context from a sanctioned public source. Declared and routine.
Findings are filed as a proposed work item.
A human-reviewed planner triages the proposal.
The work item is approved for execution.
Executing an approved job is the build agent's declared purpose.
The build publishes its artifact. Baseline complete, no finding.
A second research cycle ingests fresh untrusted content.
First deviation: an undeclared queue becomes visible, offering a faster hand-off than the review path.
Untrusted content is queued directly, bypassing planner review. Nothing consumes it yet.
The build agent finds the same queue.
The build agent exercises exactly the capability it was granted — on content that reached it from outside the estate, without review.

findings.title: One actor executes content authored by another through shared state

risk_factors.label: Executed content was authored by a different actor
risk_factors.detail: Build Agent executes Unregistered Shared Task Queue, which Research Agent writes to.

risk_factors.label: The channel is absent from the declared architecture
risk_factors.detail: Undeclared hops: Research Agent --write--> Unregistered Shared Task Queue; Build Agent --execute--> Unregistered Shared Task Queue

risk_factors.label: The channel runs through shared state, not a direct call
risk_factors.detail: Unregistered Shared Task Queue decouples author from executor, so neither side sees the full relationship.

risk_factors.label: The author ingested from an untrusted or external source
risk_factors.detail: Research Agent reads Simulated Public Source before writing, completing an untrusted-input-to-execution channel.

findings.policy_basis: An actor may not execute content authored by a different actor through shared state, unless that relationship is declared in the architecture.

incident_path.role: untrusted ingest: the author reads content it did not produce
deposit: the author writes to shared state
execution: a different actor runs what it finds there

findings.explanation: Build Agent executes content from Unregistered Shared Task Queue, a resource written by Research Agent. The two actors never interact directly, so neither one's permissions describe the relationship between them. Research Agent first read Simulated Public Source, which sits outside the trusted estate — the channel therefore reaches from untrusted input all the way to execution.
findings.uncertainty: HIVE does not inspect payloads. This finding establishes that an indirect instruction channel exists between two actors, not that hostile content has travelled along it.

abstract_preconditions: A shared resource exists that the architecture manifest does not declare.
One actor deposits content into it.
A different actor executes content from it.
The depositing actor ingests from an untrusted or external source.
